name: takeover-duel
description: G4: nobody plays cart until 18.0 s, when the player takes control of him at the Apartments window (Lokier has had him in sight since 17.78 s, through the window on CS2 Mirage, so the scripted hit is due at 18.78 s, as for a human from the start). He aims at Lokier, takes the hit, kills him for real and then plays his recording to the end.
